headline: Could neo-Nazi youth, or 'active clubs,' have played a role in Belfast riots?
context: In the wake of racist mob violence in Northern Ireland, there has been attention on "active clubs," a global network of fascist, white nationalist youth groups that center activities around mixed martial arts.
